cardData.t62: Thinking themselves protected from the plague, these poor souls doomed just as many as they saved, if not more. They still hear the screams in their dreams.
cardData.t30: {Star}{Power:FAILED OATH} {I:**Choose a tribe**. If you are wearing a plague doctor mask, Destroy all Beasties with the chosen tribe and this Beastie.}
cardData.t69: {Star}**:** {I:You may ring a Bell to target another Beastie and flip a coin. If heads, remove all Damage and Status Effect Indicators on that Beastie. If tails, the targeted Beastie and this Beastie are removed from the game.}
